summary: Stora Enso Oyj (STERV.HE, NASDAQ Helsinki) is a renewable materials, packaging and forest assets group. This Valuatum equity research report dated 24 July 2026 rates the stock BUY with a 12-month target price of EUR 13.30 versus a current price of EUR 9.17, implying roughly +45.0% upside.

The investment case is driven by Consumer Packaging margin recovery, the Oulu ramp-up and the market discount applied to forest asset NAV ahead of the planned 2027 separation of Swedish forest assets.
The central debate is whether packaging margins recover and whether Bergslagets Skogar is separated with a debt load that allows the forest NAV to be recognized rather than discounted by the market.

thesis.title: Consumer Packaging Margin Recovery
thesis.text: Consumer Packaging adjusted EBIT margin needs to recover from 6.2% to over 10.0% as Oulu ramps up and fixed costs are absorbed, supporting the value allocated to the segment.

thesis.title: Group EBIT Margin Expansion
thesis.text: Group EBIT margin is modeled to expand from 7.4% in 2026E to 9.1% by 2027E as sales grow modestly and 2027E EBITDA reaches EUR 1,520 million.

thesis.title: Discounted Forest Asset NAV
thesis.text: The market prices Stora Enso at 6.73x forward EV/EBITDA because it discounts both packaging margin recovery and the EUR 5.7 billion forest NAV pending 2027 demerger debt disclosure.

thesisBreaker: The thesis breaks if combined Nordic capacity additions permanently rebase FBB margins below 8%, or if Bergslagets Skogar is loaded with more than EUR 3bn of debt.

faqs.q: Is Stora Enso a buy in 2026?
faqs.a: Yes. Valuatum's 24 July 2026 report rates Stora Enso (STERV.HE) BUY with a 12-month target of EUR 13.30 versus a EUR 9.17 current price, implying roughly +45.0% upside.

faqs.q: What is Stora Enso's price target?
faqs.a: The 24 July 2026 Valuatum report sets a 12-month fundamental target price of EUR 13.30 for Stora Enso.

faqs.q: Why is Stora Enso considered undervalued?
faqs.a: The report highlights discounted forest asset NAV, Consumer Packaging margin recovery and the potential 2027 forest asset separation as key value drivers.

profile: Stora Enso Oyj is a Finland-headquartered renewable materials group producing fiber-based packaging materials and solutions, biomaterials, and wood products, while also owning substantial forest assets in the Nordics and Baltics. The company is restructuring its reporting and preparing to separate its Swedish forest assets into a new independently listed forest company.
